brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make an economy building game that has two modes: with and without credit. the point of the game is to demonstrate what credit and interest rates do to markets. repurposing the world of George Orwell's Animal Farm.
note: Built windmill.bisks.net: 16 seasons on Manor Farm, barter vs credit. Set your own interest rate as the Bank, over-leverage, and watch a Frederick's-forged-banknotes crash wipe you out.
